caption: The video captures a wide seascape beneath a low sun resting on the horizon behind a small cloud, throwing a golden column of light across the water. Thin wispy clouds streak the pale sky. The foreground sea churns with small breaking waves and foamy wash. A dark wave crest in the foreground advances toward the viewer as its white foam broadens along its base. The foreground wash repositions frame to frame, rolling and settling. A small dark bird-like speck enters at the upper-right edge and translates steadily leftward across the sky, descending slightly. The sun, horizon, and cloud pattern hold their positions while the water and the drifting speck supply the motion.
